title: 2 Thessalonians Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on 2 Thessalonians 2: the warning not to be shaken about the day of Christ, the man of sin, and the call to stand firm.

questions.text: By what were they not to be quickly shaken or troubled?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 warns them not to be shaken by spirit, or by word, or by letter as if from the writers, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

answers.text: By the words of the prophets
By spirit, word, or letter as if from them

questions.text: What must happen first, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says it will not be unless the rebellion comes first and the man of sin is revealed.

answers.text: The rebellion, then the man of sin
A letter comes in Paul's own hand

questions.text: What else is the man of sin called in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 calls him the man of sin, the son of destruction.

questions.text: What does he do in the temple of God, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says he opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

questions.text: What does verse 7 say already works?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says the mystery of lawlessness already works, and only there is one who restrains now.

questions.text: How will the Lord kill the lawless one?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says the Lord will kill him with the breath of his mouth and destroy him by the manifestation of his coming.

answers.text: With the breath of his mouth
With the hand of an angel

questions.text: According to whose working is the coming of the lawless one?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says his coming is according to the working of Satan, with all power and signs and lying wonders.

questions.text: What does God send those who did not receive the love of the truth?
questions.explanation: Verses 10 and 11 say that because they didn't receive the love of the truth, God sends them a working of error, that they should believe a lie.

questions.text: For what did God choose them from the beginning, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says God chose them from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth.

answers.text: For the service of the temple

questions.text: What are they told to hold in verse 15?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says: stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.

answers.text: The name of the Lord only
